subject: Improve gate deny message: hint TaskCreate for Claude Code harness
description: In hooks/orch-gate-trivial.sh, update main_session_deny_message() to detect the Claude Code harness (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID set) and output a hint directing the agent to use the native TaskCreate tool rather than "create a graph task then start_task" (which implies an MCP create tool that doesn't exist).
